bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/widgets.rs (player), springboard/src/media/ (player, stream, capture), springboard/src/deildu/player_view.rs, springboard/src/shell/camera/
summary: AVKit's playback side has partial BifrOSt counterparts: a video decoder and fullscreen player, and a floating audio mini player. Picture in Picture, route picking, display-mode choice and the capture view are modelled as pure state but not yet wired into the shell or the SDK, so apps cannot use them. The next-up proposal sheet and chapter UI, capture hardware buttons, audio input picker and Continuity Camera have no full counterpart; the PiP toggle in Settings is stored but nothing acts on it.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/player_view.rs:57 (PlayerView, ControlsStyle, VideoPlayer model), springboard/ui/src/player_view.rs (PlayerViewController, PlayerViewDelegate), springboard/src/deildu/player_view.rs (fullscreen player HUD), springboard/src/media/mod.rs, springboard/src/media/stream.rs; springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-47.rs
features.note: Fullscreen video with transport HUD is used by Deildu and Files, and springboard/ui/src/player_view.rs models the view (controls style, full-screen toggle, scrubber hit-test, play/pause, time labels), VideoPlayer(player:videoOverlay:) and PlayerViewController, which reports the will and did full-screen stages to PlayerViewDelegate, as host-tested state with no drawing or decoding (parity_sdk-complete-47.rs). Gap: the controller is not yet used by the Deildu or Files players and is not on Midget; the SDK player() widget in springboard/sdk/src/widgets.rs:900 is an audio capsule, not a video view. Headless tests in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-07.rs: headless_controls_style_maps_to_visible_chrome, headless_inline_layout_fills_the_bar_with_the_scrubber, headless_floating_and_minimal_layouts_sit_where_the_style_puts_them, headless_scrubber_hits_convert_the_x_position_to_seconds, headless_taps_toggle_play_and_seek_the_player, headless_full_screen_toggle_flips_only_when_its_button_is_shown, headless_video_area_and_outside_points, headless_time_labels_use_minutes_and_hours, headless_video_player_defaults_match_the_reference.

Only the Start PiP Automatically preference exists; no floating video window is drawn, no app-facing start/stop API, and nothing reads pip_auto when the Home button is pressed. Built 2026-10-17: SDK bifrost_app::picture_in_picture (Pip: controller, window rect, corner snapping); tests springboard/sdk/src/picture_in_picture.rs::tests. Shell placement not wired yet.

No trim control in the player HUD (springboard/src/deildu/player_view.rs). Wired into the UI in wiring wave 2 (0.5.38); verify on Midget for parity. The mode choice is a headless model: the closest refresh rate in the requested dynamic range wins, a tie goes to the higher rate, a request no mode can meet cancels a pending switch, and a retargeted request replaces an earlier one (ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-05.rs). Still missing: no display mode switching API in the shell or apps, and the model has not been run against a panel on Midget; the video path is in springboard/src/media/ only.

Audit 2026-10-13: the row predated this code. Pure model with host unit tests (route_picker.rs, route_picker_view.rs); not wired into the shell or apps, not tested on Midget. Settings page only; no route picker view. Deildu serves a LAN URL so an external TV can play the stream (springboard/CHANGELOG.md), which is not an AVRoutePicker equivalent.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/camera/mod.rs (viewfinder, silent shutter, timer, grid, QR), springboard/src/shell/camera/qr.rs, springboard/ui/src/capture_view.rs; springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-47.rs
features.note: The Camera app is a shell app, not an SDK view. springboard/ui/src/capture_view.rs models the capture view as pure state: session binding with video and audio preview flags, controls style, video gravity, and the start-recording delegate event with its refusals (headless tests in parity_sdk-complete-47.rs). Gap: not wired into the SDK or the Camera app, and no preview is drawn; needs the Midget camera for verification.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 5 (w5-avkit, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No hardware capture button handler; the shutter is on-screen only.

Front and back switching exists in the Camera app. springboard/ui/src/capture_direction.rs models the direction coordinator and its map as pure state: forward and backward lists relative to a view, a device-type filter, sorted lists, and a change report only when the grouping differs (headless tests in parity_sdk-complete-47.rs). Gap: not wired to the capture service or the SDK, and the camera list comes from no live device; needs the Midget cameras for verification.

The picker model gives each offered input with a flag for the chosen one, clears the choice back to the system default, and drops a choice whose microphone has gone; headless tests in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-06.rs. Not wired into apps or the shell, and no SDK API or picker sheet exists yet; the audio service needs the lab machine to check the device list.

features.apple: Camera in Split View, Slide Over, PiP, Stage Manager
features.note: BifrOSt has no iPad multitasking modes; the camera runs only in the shell's Camera app.
Apple device pairing; no counterpart planned in the repo.
verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 3 tests. Media errors exist as a Rust Error enum; no AVKit error codes, and the content-restriction codes have no counterpart.

gaps: Picture in Picture: no floating video window or PiP controller API in the shell; springboard/ui/src/pip_window.rs is a model only, and the Settings toggle pip_auto (springboard/src/shell/options.rs:72) is stored but never read by the shell.

App-facing video player view: the SDK player() widget (springboard/sdk/src/widgets.rs:900) draws audio only; the fullscreen video HUD lives in springboard/src/deildu/player_view.rs and is not reusable by other apps.

Route picker: springboard/ui/src/route_picker.rs and route_picker_view.rs are models only. No receiver discovery feeds them and nothing draws the picker; the AirPlay & Handoff page (springboard/src/shell/pages.rs:598) is a settings screen only.
Capture: springboard/ui/src/capture_view.rs is a model only. There is no SDK capture view or delegate in use, and the camera is a single shell app (springboard/src/shell/camera/mod.rs).
Capture events: springboard/ui/src/capture_event.rs is not wired to a hardware button handler.
Audio input picker: audiod records (springboard/audiod/src/main.rs) but apps cannot choose a microphone through a system picker.
Display management: springboard/ui/src/display_manager.rs chooses modes but is not wired into the SDK; HDR is not covered on hardware.
Content proposals and trimming have no shell counterpart; trimming is wired in the media apps only.
